title: When ideas connect, links outgrow ideas

scenes.title: One idea becomes a connected system
scenes.purpose: Show that each new idea adds links to every earlier idea, so possible links grow faster than the number of ideas: L = n(n−1)/2, ending at 6 ideas → 15 links.
visuals: Dark navy-teal stage with a vignette and a faint fixed grid
Static title and the formula subtitle
Teal shaded idea nodes on a hexagon ring, inside a translucent system hull that grows
Ochre links that draw outward from each new node, with a short warm glow
n and L counters under the network
Violet L(n) curve and shaded area climbing point by point
Teal corner brackets and the result pill '6 ideas → 15 links'

beats.development: The title and formula are readable. The first idea node appears with a glow; the counters show n = 1 and L = 0, and the chart tip sits at (1, 0).
captions: When ideas connect, links outgrow ideas
Possible links between n ideas: L = n(n−1)/2

beats.development: Ideas 2 to 6 arrive about every 0.32 s. Each one emerges from the edge of the hull, which grows to include it. Its links then draw to every earlier node, and the counters step to L = 1, 3, 6, 10 and 15. At the same time the violet curve climbs to each (n, L) point.
Corner brackets mark the finished network and the n = 6 point. The result pill '6 ideas → 15 links' appears as one unit and holds while everything is still.

findings: Only one new idea is in focus at a time. The chart moves with the network so the eye can track both, and the counters confirm each step.
All motion settles by 2.40 s, before the 2.7 s limit.
justifiedHolds: 2.40–3.00 s: the finished network, curve and conclusion are held still so the result can be read.

notes: The background is a dark navy-teal stage, chosen for a networking/data-flow subject following BACKGROUND_REVIEW guidance. It replaces the earlier warm cream.
Colour meanings stay fixed: teal = idea, ochre = link, violet = L(n).
